record.paper: Separating the edges of a graph by a linear number of paths

dossier_meta.paper: Separating the edges of a graph by a linear number of paths
dossier_meta.statement_text: Does every graph on $n$ vertices admit a strongly-separating path system of size $2n$?
dossier_meta.context_text: The upper bound of $19n$ from Theorem 2 is likely far from optimal. Balogh et al. showed that the complete bipartite graph $K_{\varepsilon n,(1-\varepsilon)n}$ cannot be strongly separated by fewer than $2(1-2\varepsilon)n$ paths, but no graph with a larger lower bound is known, suggesting the optimal constant might be $2$.
